tools.name: search_labs
tools.description: Find accredited labs and matching scope lines for a standard. Each result states its match basis.

tools.name: verify_lab
tools.description: Check scope evidence by lab slug or accreditation number, not lab name. Each evidence result states its match basis.

tools.name: enquiry_link
tools.description: Return a link to the lab's enquiry form on ScopeMatch, prefilled with the test details. The person reviews the form and sends it on the website; this tool sends nothing.
